question: A group of students has an average weight of 44 kg. One student of weight 40 kg leaves the group and another student of weight 34 kg joins the group. If the new average weight becomes 43.4 kg, then how many students are there in the group?

Old average weight = 44 kg, after 40 kg student leaves and 34 kg student joins then the new average weight becomes 43.4 kg.
